tagline: An objective becomes lanes, cards and effectors; a budgeted loop over Google Scholar
role: The v2 search agent: one model proposes cluster-slicing strategies (temporal, structural, conceptual, relational, epistemic), the operator approves 4–7 lanes with term pools and cards, and the agent executes adaptively inside a sovereign query budget, declaring a named move (BROADEN, TIGHTEN, PRUNE, RE-WINDOW, GO DEEPER, ANCHOR, WALK CITATIONS…) and harvesting terms at every evaluation. Truth ledger, program frontier, finish gate and tail director keep it honest. The Reporter's news loop is its direct descendant.
contributes: search engines: slicing lenses, lane/card program, term harvest, adjustment repertoire, query anatomy, batch judging, reverse citation test
budgeting: two-pool budget, derive_budgets, model seats
ledgers: truth, frontier, critique, improvement, identity
the LLM-first doctrine (judgment placement, dead-channel law)
